adds.title: Census of India 2011 / Goa electoral rolls 2022-2024
adds.summary: The 2011 Census recorded 398 transgender persons in Goa out of 487,803 nationally.

adds.title: National Legal Services Authority v. Union of India (2014)
adds.summary: On 15 April 2014 the Supreme Court recognized hijras/transgenders as a third gender who could no longer be forced to identify as male or female and required their treatment as socially and economically backward with OBC reservation in educational admission and employment, Centre and state social welfare schemes, public awareness to erase stigma, construction of special public toilets and provision for special medical needs, legal entitlement to affirmed sex after surgical change without discrimination, and protection from harassment and discrimination including misuse of IPC section 377, with the ruling limited to eunuchs/hijras/transgenders and not to gay, lesbian and bisexual persons.

adds.title: Kerala Government proposal for free gender affirmation surgery (2016) and reimbursement/scholarship scheme
adds.summary: In November 2015 Kerala adopted India's first transgender policy to improve living conditions, and in March 2016 the social justice department proposed free sex-reassignment surgery in government hospitals, at least in medical colleges, from the next financial year, addressing the absence of any SRS facility in-state that forced travel to Chennai/Bengaluru for procedures costing Rs 2-5 lakh for male-to-female and Rs 4-8 lakh for female-to-male plus 6 months-2 years counselling, 1+ year hormone therapy and post-surgery observation, with implementation pending health ministry approval and training of multidisciplinary urology, endocrinology, sexology and psychology teams, alongside a transgender-owned and operated G Taxi equality-taxi service for all passengers to provide livelihood and public visibility, in a context where ~25,000 transgender persons were estimated in-state with ~81% wishing to transition and 76% concealing identity for fear of non-acceptance.
